title: FalldropBackport
description: Backporting minecraft features from 26.3to the latest versions
body: ![Dappled Forest Tent](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3518b1e561cc9933902ab8650993fc7d5ad3602_0.webp) Backporting the features of 26.3 minecraft gamedrop to the latest versions(26.1.2 & 26.2.x). This mod add - Poplar woodset - Poplar trees - Red Orange and Yellow leaves - Abandoned camp in all their variants - Woll slabs and stairs - Shelf Mushroom - Red Shrub - Poplar Sapling This mod is working progress and will be udpdated with all the features the drop will include.
